verdict.rationale: Webhook event subscriptions are a fair question for a memory-API SaaS like Supermemory, so the axis applies. The only webhook mention describes connectors that auto-sync from Google Drive, Notion and similar sources via real-time webhooks. That is inbound sync into Supermemory, not documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a user can subscribe to, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
